package.name: carto_localization
package.description:
Loop-closure-corrected 2-D localisation using Cartographer.
Converts SimEnv's legacy /scan (sensor_msgs/PointCloud, frame laser_livox, a 3-D Livox Mid-360 pitched +45 deg) into a 2-D LaserScan, then runs Cartographer (2-D, pure scan matching, use_odometry=false) to produce a drift-free carto_map frame via loop closure. This package is fully independent of the navigation stack: it does not touch competition_navigation_node.py or any exploration logic.
